participants.note: tested and ACKed the bitcoin-tx changes
Approach ACKed but raised three issues regarding consensus validity and fuzz test regressions, all resolved
Concept ACKed containerizing legacy wallet code and removing the outdated provider

claims.harm: signing P2SH redeemScripts over 520 bytes produces consensus-invalid transactions with Push value size limit exceeded
claims.quote: This branch fixes P2WSH, which now makes it into the mempool, and also signs P2SH, producing a transaction that is consensus-invalid with `Push value size limit exceeded`.
claims.settled_by_quote: I added a commit to enforce this in signing.

claims.harm: LoadCScript returning true for scripts over 520 bytes causes an accounting mismatch in spkm_migration fuzz testing
claims.quote: For a script over 520 bytes `LoadCScript` returns true without storing it, where `AddCScript` returned false. So `added_script` counts a script that was never stored, and the `>=` branch runs instead of the exact-equality one.

claims.harm: script_sign fuzz test fails to look up P2WPKH scripts previously added implicitly for compressed keys
claims.quote: `AddKey(k)` also answered `GetPubKey()` and, for compressed keys, inserted the P2WPKH script P2SH-P2WPKH needs. The current `script_sign` corpus finds both, and with only `provider.keys` those lookups start failing.

support.reason: ACK for the bitcoin-tx changes. Will try to review the remaining parts
to containerise the codepath related to legacy wallets while discouraging usage of this seemingly outdated signing provider.
